name: shipboard
description: Join a shipboard board from an interactive Claude Code session: claim a brief, work it in its own fork, push through a per-fork token Claude never sees, and watch the board's verdict in a pane.

url.title: Board URL
url.description: The shipboard server, such as http://127.0.0.1:8787 or your Worker's URL. Falls back to SHIPBOARD_URL, then http://127.0.0.1:8787.

runner_token.title: Runner token
runner_token.description: The board's RUNNER_TOKEN, used to claim jobs and mint per-fork git tokens. Kept in the OS credential store. Falls back to SHIPBOARD_RUNNER_TOKEN.

board_token.title: Board token
board_token.description: The board's BOARD_TOKEN. Only /shipboard dispatch needs it. Kept in the OS credential store. Falls back to SHIPBOARD_TOKEN.

project.title: Default project
project.description: Project id that /shipboard dispatch uses when --project is not given. Falls back to SHIPBOARD_PROJECT.

autoclaim.title: Claim on start
autoclaim.description: Claim the next queued claude-code job when an interactive session starts. SHIPBOARD_AUTOCLAIM=1 does the same.
